label: Observed intensity measure, with relative error

inputs.name: im
inputs.description: The intensity measure at this bridge that is measured.

instance_schema.description: Which intensity measure is observed, as which quantity, and the measurement's relative standard deviation.

observed.description: The quantity the measurement is: SAObs(1.0) for SA(1.0).

relative_sd.description: epsilon: the measurement's standard deviation as a fraction of the true value.

description: IM_obs ~ N(IM, (epsilon IM)^2) at each bridge, independently: a measurement whose error grows with the value. It has no children, so unobserved it changes nothing upstream; observed, it is a likelihood on the bridge's IM.
